name: cdm/legaldocumentation/master/MasterAgreementVariableSet
description: Defines a type where additional variables associated to clauses and their variants can be described.

variableSet.description: For some variants a table of variables is required. To support this use case we need to be able to specify variables within variables. Including a variable set here gives us infinite nesting opportunities - realistically we are only ever expecting that a table would need to be defined for any particular clause, so we would expect two levels of nesting as a maximum i.e. variableSet->variableSet->name/value.
